stages.title: MAHZAR: SCOPE BEFORE SIGNIFICANCE

pills.text: QUALIFIED JURISTS DISAGREE ON A RELIGIOUS/LEGAL QUESTION
WELFARE OF MANKIND + PROPER ADMINISTRATIVE ORDER
MAY BE ISSUED ONLY WITHOUT CONTRADICTING EXPLICIT QURAN/HADIS
JURISTIC MONOPOLY NARROWS; IMPERIAL ARBITRATION STRENGTHENS
NEITHER POPE/PROPHET NOR UNLIMITED SACRED LEGISLATION.

sequence: TRIGGER → qualified jurists disagree on a religious/legal question
CHOICE → emperor selects an existing opinion
TEST → welfare of mankind + proper administrative order
ORDER → may be issued only without contradicting explicit Quran/hadis
EFFECT → juristic monopoly narrows; imperial arbitration strengthens
